title: CatalogRecord
responsibility: Stores revision-bound verification records in catalog_records through a supplied persistence adapter.

inputs.name: CatalogRecord.id
inputs.description: Primary key used for catalog_records lookups and writes; this model forwards the supplied string and does not generate or parse an ID.

inputs.name: CatalogRecord.commit
inputs.description: Commit identifier associated with the stored record; this model treats it as an opaque string and does not validate its SHA format.

inputs.name: CatalogRecord.status
inputs.description: Status string stored alongside the record; the model does not restrict its vocabulary or derive it from other fields.

inputs.name: CatalogRecord.valid
inputs.description: Boolean validity value stored with the record; the model does not compute or check it.

inputs.name: CatalogRecord.data
inputs.description: JSON payload with the IndexedRecord fields; the model forwards it without parsing or validating its contents.

outputs.name: CatalogRecord.find
outputs.description: Promise resolving to the adapter's matching catalog_records row or null when it reports no match; this model does not validate the returned row.

outputs.name: CatalogRecord.findBy
outputs.description: Promise resolving to the rows the adapter returns for the supplied attribute filter; matching semantics and ordering are adapter-defined.

outputs.name: CatalogRecord.create
outputs.description: Promise resolving to the row returned by the adapter after creation; this model adds no generated fields or defaults.

outputs.name: CatalogRecord.update
outputs.description: Promise resolving to the adapter's updated row or null when it reports no match; patch application is adapter-defined.

outputs.name: CatalogRecord.delete
outputs.description: Promise resolving to the adapter's boolean deletion result; the model does not reinterpret what true or false means.

errors.name: Persistence operation failure
errors.description: Synchronous adapter throws and rejected adapter promises propagate without being caught or converted. Copying filter or create/update input objects can also throw while reading enumerable getters.

inputs.name: CatalogRecord.find.adapter
inputs.description: Persistence adapter receiving the find call for catalog_records; this model delegates storage to it and owns no connection lifecycle.

inputs.name: CatalogRecord.find.id
inputs.description: Row ID looked up in catalog_records and passed unchanged to the adapter; this model does not generate or parse it.

outputs.name: CatalogRecord.find
outputs.description: Promise resolving to the adapter's matching catalog_records row or null when it reports no match; this model does not validate the returned row.

errors.name: Persistence operation failure
errors.description: Synchronous throws from adapter.find and rejected adapter promises propagate unchanged; this model performs no argument copying for this call.

inputs.name: CatalogRecord.findBy.adapter
inputs.description: Persistence adapter receiving the findBy call for catalog_records; this model delegates storage to it and owns no connection lifecycle.

inputs.name: CatalogRecord.findBy.fields
inputs.description: Partial stored attributes copied at the top level and passed to adapter.findBy as filters; matching behavior is adapter-defined.

outputs.name: CatalogRecord.findBy
outputs.description: Promise resolving to the rows the adapter returns for the supplied attribute filter; matching semantics and ordering are adapter-defined.

errors.name: Persistence operation failure
errors.description: Synchronous throws from adapter.findBy and rejected adapter promises propagate unchanged. Spreading fields can also throw while reading an enumerable getter.

inputs.name: CatalogRecord.create.adapter
inputs.description: Persistence adapter receiving the create call for catalog_records; this model delegates storage to it and owns no connection lifecycle.

inputs.name: CatalogRecord.create.input
inputs.description: Complete CatalogRecordAttributes object copied at the top level and passed to adapter.create; this model does not generate fields, validate the payload, or set defaults.

outputs.name: CatalogRecord.create
outputs.description: Promise resolving to the row returned by the adapter after creation; this model adds no generated fields or defaults.

errors.name: Persistence operation failure
errors.description: Synchronous throws from adapter.create and rejected adapter promises propagate unchanged. Spreading input can also throw while reading an enumerable getter.

inputs.name: CatalogRecord.update.adapter
inputs.description: Persistence adapter receiving the update call for catalog_records; this model delegates storage to it and owns no connection lifecycle.

inputs.name: CatalogRecord.update.id
inputs.description: Row ID selected for update and passed unchanged to the adapter; this model does not generate or parse it.

inputs.name: CatalogRecord.update.input
inputs.description: Partial CatalogRecordAttributes without id, copied at the top level and passed to adapter.update; field merging is the adapter's responsibility.

outputs.name: CatalogRecord.update
outputs.description: Promise resolving to the adapter's updated row or null when it reports no match; patch application is adapter-defined.

errors.name: Persistence operation failure
errors.description: Synchronous throws from adapter.update and rejected adapter promises propagate unchanged. Spreading input can also throw while reading an enumerable getter.

inputs.name: CatalogRecord.delete.adapter
inputs.description: Persistence adapter receiving the delete call for catalog_records; this model delegates storage to it and owns no connection lifecycle.

inputs.name: CatalogRecord.delete.id
inputs.description: Row ID selected for deletion and passed unchanged to the adapter; this model does not generate or parse it.

outputs.name: CatalogRecord.delete
outputs.description: Promise resolving to the adapter's boolean deletion result; the model does not reinterpret what true or false means.

errors.name: Persistence operation failure
errors.description: Synchronous throws from adapter.delete and rejected adapter promises propagate unchanged; this model performs no argument copying for this call.
